S3Workbench.name: S3UnifiedWorkbench
S3Workbench.summary: Single integrated Qt & browser Workbench coordinating 4D scenario authoring, fail-closed preflight, multi-sensor execution, and passive replay.

SceneSnapshot.name: SceneSnapshot
SceneSnapshot.summary: Immutable 4D ENU/WGS84 world timebase holding exact sampled platform and target poses, velocities, 6-DoF attitudes, terrain bounds, and SHA-256 content digest.

ObjectSourceEvidence.name: ObjectSourceEvidence
ObjectSourceEvidence.summary: Per-object synthetic geometry, material, spectral/RF band support, and explicit uncertainty contract. Enforces 6-DoF rigid-body rotation preserving edge lengths and normals.

PreflightGate.name: SensorExecutionPlan & Preflight
PreflightGate.summary: Zero-write, fail-closed admission gate checking memory/work budgets, RMB training support (K >= 2*DOF), spatial aliasing, and receive-gate bounds before any IQ allocation.

SharedRadarAdapter.name: SharedRadarAdapter
SharedRadarAdapter.summary: Common-CPI coherent radar producer executing LFM transmit/receive, pulse compression, Doppler RDM, CA-CFAR, monopulse, and closed-loop tracking with zero truth leakage.

SharedSarAdapter.name: SharedSarAdapter
SharedSarAdapter.summary: Coherent spotlight & stripmap SAR producer with per-pulse moving-target phase histories, 3D DEM/building occlusion, flat z=0 and terrain-referenced z=h_DEM(x,y) backprojection, and PFA.

SharedIRAdapter.name: SharedIRAdapter
SharedIRAdapter.summary: Physics-produced synthetic LWIR/MWIR radiometric imager with 6-DoF rigid-body facet rotation, ray-cast z-buffer occlusion, Planck band quadrature, and explicit NoData masking.

HybridReceiver.name: HybridSubarrayReceiver & Channelizer
HybridReceiver.summary: Two-stage analog-element to digital-subarray combiner with 4-tap polyphase / FFT subband channelizer producing one immutable (S,P,R,F) cube sealed by full-metadata SHA-256.

AdaptiveBranches.name: Paired Conventional / STAP / Joint SFAP
AdaptiveBranches.summary: Runs Conventional, GIP-screened Post-Doppler STAP, Per-Subband SFAP, and Joint Space×Frequency SFAP plus CA-CFAR, subarray monopulse, and Kalman tracking on the exact same frozen capture.

SealedArchive.name: Sealed HDF5 & Passive Session Viewer
SealedArchive.summary: Immutable HDF5 archives (radar.h5, sar.h5 v2, ir.h5, HBF2 trade ledger) and session.json verified by SHA-256 digests. Passive multi-layer viewing and replay never re-execute sources.

ConstraintRMB.name: RMB Training Support
ConstraintRMB.summary: Reed-Mallett-Brennan covariance conditioning bound: secondary training cell count K must satisfy K >= 2 * DOF (2*S for STAP/per-subband, 2*S*F for Joint Space×Frequency SFAP) or fail closed.

ConstraintAliasing.name: SAR Spatial Aliasing & Gate
ConstraintAliasing.summary: Ensures pulse-to-pulse slant-range change satisfies 4*pi*f_max*|DeltaR|/c <= pi and every scatterer/DEM pixel fits completely inside the declared fast-time receive gate.

ConstraintMonopulse.name: Monopulse Coherence & Hemisphere
ConstraintMonopulse.summary: Digital subarray monopulse azimuth estimates require coherence SNR >= 6 dB and forward-hemisphere |sin(az)| < 0.999; uncalibrated or low-SNR plots are rejected without truth rescue.

ConstraintBudget.name: Pre-Allocation Compute & Memory Cap
ConstraintBudget.summary: Analytical cube-byte and MFLOP/CPI caps are checked before any IQ allocation; rejected configurations are logged as rejected_preflight_not_executed.

multi_level_requirements.shall: The S³ system shall store every authored mission scenario as an immutable, SHA-256-sealed 4D SceneSnapshot with explicit WGS84/ENU origin, vertical datum, and monotonic sample timestamps prior to executing any sensor plugin.
multi_level_requirements.rationale: Prevents browser Cesium presentation state from drifting away from authoritative simulation truth.
multi_level_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Identical config and seed produce identical world.content_digest; mutating any pose changes the digest.

multi_level_requirements.shall: The S³ Authoritative World subsystem shall represent unknown target or terrain elevations explicitly as height_known=false / NaN rather than substituting z=0.0 m.
multi_level_requirements.rationale: Prevents silent elevation fabrication in SAR layover and IR occlusion.
multi_level_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Unknown-height entity fails closed in IR and SAR preflight before engine execution.

multi_level_requirements.shall: When 6-DoF attitude rotation is enabled, the S³ Rigid-Body Facet Transform model shall rotate facet vertices and outward normals via a proper orthogonal ENU matrix R = Rz(yaw) Ry(pitch) Rx(roll) preserving triangle edge lengths and areas within 1e-12 relative tolerance.
multi_level_requirements.rationale: Guarantees rigid-body geometric fidelity across multi-epoch rotating IR exposures.
multi_level_requirements.acceptance_criteria: ||R^T R - I||_max <= 1e-12, |det(R) - 1| <= 1e-12, edge/area parity <= 1e-12; default allow_attitude_rotation=False fails closed.

multi_level_requirements.shall: The S³ system shall bind all sensor products generated from a multi-sensor run to the identical scene_sha256 and seal every HDF5 archive with fail-closed SHA-256 integrity checks.
multi_level_requirements.rationale: Guarantees cross-sensor spatial-temporal registration and tamper-evident passive replay.
multi_level_requirements.acceptance_criteria: verify_cross_sensor_spatial_temporal_registration passes across RF, SAR, and IR on king_farm_civilian and south_mountain_civilian.

multi_level_requirements.shall: The S³ Sampled SAR subsystem shall focus both flat z=0 and terrain-referenced z=h_DEM(x,y) backprojection from the identical immutable SarAcquisitionHistory and propagate NaN for unknown DEM pixels without fabricating z=0.
multi_level_requirements.rationale: Quantifies terrain layover correction without altering raw phase history.
multi_level_requirements.acceptance_criteria: 80 m elevated target shows >60 m layover in z=0 and |y| <= 2 m in DEM focus; NaN DEM propagates NaN; zero-DEM matches z=0 within 1e-13.

multi_level_requirements.shall: The S³ Joint Space×Frequency SFAP model shall enforce the Reed-Mallett-Brennan training bound K >= 2 * S * F prior to covariance inversion and fail closed without fabricating adaptive weights when K < 2 * S * F.
multi_level_requirements.rationale: Prevents singular or ill-conditioned covariance inversion in wideband adaptive processing.
multi_level_requirements.acceptance_criteria: K < 2*S*F fails closed; admitted dispersive multipath case shows positive SINR gain over per-subband SFAP.

multi_level_requirements.shall: The S³ Mission Authoring subsystem shall require explicit human approval of any agent-proposed scenario draft before creating an executable SensorExecutionPlan and shall prohibit arbitrary code execution, unapproved writes, or hardware/RF actuation.
multi_level_requirements.rationale: Enforces fail-closed security and instructor authority in AI-assisted educational authoring.
multi_level_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Unapproved or script-bearing drafts rejected with zero writes; max entity/duration bounds TBD for owner decision.

multi_level_requirements.shall: When a LiDAR plugin is added, the S³ LiDAR subsystem shall compute ray-surface returns against shared SceneSnapshot geometry/DEM in ENU metres and omit or mark occluded/out-of-range rays rather than fabricating synthetic ranges.
multi_level_requirements.rationale: Extends S³ to 3D point clouds while maintaining occlusion and uncertainty honesty.
multi_level_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Analytic ray-plane accuracy within TBD m (owner decision); occluded target returns zero points.

archipelago_slices.title: Radar Detection (2D CA-CFAR → Plot Extraction)
archipelago_slices.pipeline: Complex RDM (D, R) → Magnitude |X| → Rectangular Guard/Training Window → Threshold T = alpha * mean(Training) → Detection Mask → Plot Peak Selection → Tracker Observations
equations: T(d, r) = alpha * hat_n(d, r)   [direct threshold_scale, not closed-form Pfa]
archipelago_slices.limits: edge_policy='skip' leaves border cells NaN; homogeneous background assumed; raw CFAR bins are distinct from post-CFAR accepted plots.

archipelago_slices.title: Multi-Target Tracking (Scan Kalman & Association)
archipelago_slices.pipeline: Cartesian Observations + R_k → Constant-Velocity Predict → Gating → Deterministic Association (nearest_neighbor | global_one_to_one) → Kalman Update / Coast → Track Initiation → Offline Truth Scoring
equations: P_{k|k-1} = F P F^T + Q(dt),   S = H P_{k|k-1} H^T + R_k
archipelago_slices.limits: kalman_scan.py supports ONLY nearest_neighbor and global_one_to_one (explicitly NOT PDA/JPDA/MHT; standalone IMM/JPDA lives separately in radar_engineering/imm_jpda.py).

archipelago_slices.title: Range-Doppler Map (RDM) Formation
archipelago_slices.pipeline: Pulse-Compressed IQ (P, R) → Slow-Time Window (hann | None) → Axis-0 FFT → fftshift (0 Hz at P//2) → Magnitude / Power → Physical Axes (m, Hz, m/s)
equations: Delta_R = c / (2 * f_s),   v_r = f_d * (c / (2 * f_c))
archipelago_slices.limits: Window limited to 'hann' or None; speeds |v_r| >= PRF*lambda/4 alias; no range-cell migration compensation in base RDM.

archipelago_slices.title: EO/IR Radiometric Image Formation (LWIR / MWIR)
archipelago_slices.pipeline: SceneSnapshot 6-DoF Pose → Rigid Facet Rotation → Pinhole Ray-Cast & Z-Buffer Occlusion → Planck Band Quadrature (LWIR 8-12 um | MWIR 3-5 um) → Detector Noise & ADC → Validity Mask → Display Palette
equations: L_tot = tau_atm * (eps * L_bb(T) + (1 - eps) * L_bb(T_bg)) + L_path
archipelago_slices.limits: Opaque diffuse facets, held exposure-start pose, zero PSF in SharedIRAdapter for explicit NoData masking; Visible EO and SWIR are not in this radiometric chain. The Studio camera's EO and SWIR bands (studio_ir_renderer.js) are display renderers outside it.

archipelago_slices.title: SAR Image Formation (z=0 vs 3D DEM Backprojection & PFA)
archipelago_slices.pipeline: Moving/Occluded 4D Targets → Stop-and-Go LFM Phase History (raw_iq) → Matched-Filter Compression → Paired Backprojection (z=0 AND z=h_DEM(x,y)) → Sealed s3-sampled-sar-export-v2
equations: s_rx(p, t) = sum_s rho_s * illum[p,s] * exp(-j 4 pi f_c R[p,s] / c) * s_tx(t - 2 R[p,s]/c)
I(x, y, z) = (1 / (P * E_tx)) * sum_p s_comp(p, tau(p; x,y,z)) * exp(+j 4 pi f_c R_assumed / c)
archipelago_slices.limits: Scalar monostatic point/centroid field; NaN DEM propagates NaN; PFA rejects stripmap mode and far-field curvature violations.

governance_gates.title: Baseline promotion gate
governance_gates.purpose: A candidate requirement, ConOps or epic baseline moves from CANDIDATE_UNAPPROVED to APPROVED_BASELINE only with a named human reviewer, a real date, the exact verified commit, sealed passing evidence and an acknowledged synthetic non-claim. A merged PR or a green test run cannot promote anything by itself.

controls.control: Human reviewer approves sealed, passing evidence

governance_gates.title: AI mission authoring gate
governance_gates.purpose: An AI authoring agent may only propose fictional scenes, routes, sensor placements and objectives. The gate rejects actuation, execution of unsupported sensors, impossible motion and truth leakage, and only a named human reviewer approving the exact sealed proposal can release it for simulation.

controls.control: Agent asks for live RF transmit
Approval names a stale proposal digest
Human reviewer approves the exact proposal

qualification.title: Multi-CPI slow-mover (DMTI) qualification

checks.check: Head-on walker spreads Doppler more than broadside
Wind-blown foliage has heavier slow-mover tails than a matched Gaussian
Vertical polarization nearly vanishes at the Brewster angle
Walking dismount classified from the post-STAP residual
Frozen (rigid) control classified as a vehicle
Walk-stop-resume walker held as one track
Tracker believes the walker stopped during the pause
No confirmed false tracks on clutter only

qualification.limits: Synthetic educational models with one deterministic seed. These are physics and tracking sanity gates, not detection-probability claims or field performance.

repository_scale.note: Test functions defined in the repository; parametrized cases run more. This is not a pass count.
